listing.name: Saru Get You: Saru Saru Daisakusen (Ape Escape Mind Over Monkey)
listing.summary: An experimental PSP Saru Get You: Saru Saru Daisakusen port. Its game profile reports early macOS startup/audio, Linux ARM64 startup and a Windows cross-build. Later root documentation and releases claim broader support and contradict the profile’s no-release/Android-unavailable statements; neither proves Android installation or gameplay. The SaruSaru launcher builds locally from your own Japanese UCJS10060 v1.00 compatible ISO; exact ISO hashes are unconfirmed. Source preparation needs CMake, Ninja, Python and a compiler, and PSPRecomp does not supply decryption. An optional interpreter handles code outside translated coverage. macOS ARM64, Linux x86-64/ARM64, Windows x86-64 and Android ARM64 launcher/build routes are documented, with their evidence differences unresolved. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
